anchor_age: No FHIR element. Patient.birthDate stores only (anchor_year - anchor_age); no anchor_age extension exists, so anchor_age is not recoverable exactly and is emitted as typed NULL.
anchor_year: No FHIR element. Patient.birthDate stores only (anchor_year - anchor_age); min(year(Encounter.period.start)) is approximately 99% recoverable but not exact, so anchor_year is emitted as typed NULL.
